messages:
Alex R: Evening folks — planning to bump Slate reserve pool by +2 GPUs for reserved-slate at 20:30 UTC tonight. Who's owning rollout and rollback? :wave:
Priya S: I can own smoke checks. Will be on call at 20:30 UTC. I'll run the smoke script and check latency + error rates.
Lucas M: I'll kick the infra deploy and monitor pool health. Tagging Emma for routing validation.
Emma K: @Lucas M I'm ready for routing validation. I'll run quick perf checks against canary slices right before cutover.
Ben T: Heads-up: the autoscale-policy change includes minBurst=2 -> 3. Left a short note in PR 789.
Ben T: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/789
Kara O: Oncall coverage confirmed 20:25-21:00 UTC. If rollback is needed, ping me immediately.
Alex R: Thanks. Smoke checklist (Priya / Emma):
```
- run ./scripts/smoke_reserve_slate.sh --pool slate
- check metrics: slate.reserve.lat_p50, slate.reserve.lat_p95, slate.reserve.error_rate
- verify no new OOMs or evictions on reserved hosts
- confirm no unintended routing changes to hosted API
```
Priya S: I'll paste results here within 5m of running.
Emma K: For routing validation I'll run curl against the canary and compare token latency:
```
curl -sS 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=slate-canary' -H 'authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_TOKEN' | jq '.latency_ms'
```
Lucas M: Rollback plan: revert infra config, trigger config-roll job: `make config-rollback POOL=slate`. Target rollback completion <= 5m.
Alex R: If anyone sees token spikes or >5% error rate, abort and rollback. Tag @Kara O to escalate.
Ben T: I'll be near my laptop; can push a hotfix if minBurst tweak causes issues.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy job created: job/dep-3567801234-slate-bump — ETA 20:30 UTC
Priya S: smoke run complete: p50 23ms -> 24ms, p95 180ms -> 190ms, errors unchanged. No OOMs. :thumbsup:
Emma K: routing check ok, token latency within expected variance. :eyes:
Lucas M: starting deploy now (20:30 UTC)
deploy-bot: job/dep-3567801234-slate-bump started
Alex R: ping me with a short summary when done.
deploy-bot: job/dep-3567801234-slate-bump succeeded in 45s
Lucas M: deploy finished. observed a small latency blip at +10s but recovered. No evictions.
Priya S: Monitoring for 15m; current error rate stable. All good from smoke side.
Kara O: Oncall confirms no alerts seen. Closing loop.
Alex R: Thanks team — marking rollout complete and updating the rollout board.
